simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֵמָר (H2564) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חֵמָר (chêmâr) means bitumen (as rising to the surface) First listed occurrence: Exod 2 3.

definitions.full: H2564. chemar חֵמָר noun [masculine] bitumen, asphalt (from I. חמר according to OBlau ZMG 1869, 279, bitumen as seething, swelling up ; Thes MV, from IV. חמר , with reference to reddish-brown colour) — חֵמָר Gen 11:3 2 t.; used for cement in building Babel 11:3 (J); abounding in vale of Siddim ח בֶּאֱרֹת ׳בֶּאֱרֹת 14:10 ; used in coating Moses' 'ark' of bulrushes Exod 2:3 (E; || זָ֑פֶת ).
